component.name: Suite Help
component.summary: The code explorer and handbook, offline

description.p: Suite Help is the documentation reader for the Suite: a Browser, Modules and Tours explorer over a generated code index, plus the handbook built from the repository's Markdown. It works offline and owns no document.
This flatpak is the same build as the other artifact forms; Flatpak is a second way to install it, not a different application. Flatpak owns updates.
